content: This text contains a time and code for a PNG HD channel, followed by instructions for resetting a password and watching content on a mobile app. It is also available for download on the App Store and Google Play.
The message announces a new show featuring Angélica María on Canela TV and encourages viewers to download the Canela TV app from Google Play. It also mentions resetting the password for the service.

The Canela TV app allows users to access a variety of entertainment options such as movies, series, channels, Canelakids, music, and sports. Users can also reset their password and find information about the service on Canela TV's website. The app is available for download on Google Play.
